import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
lines = Path('component.go').read_text().splitlines()
checks = [dict(id=f'C{i}', kind='claim', statement=statement, line=line, fragment=lines[line-1]) for i, (line, statement) in enumerate(json.loads(sys.argv[1]),1)]
Path('analysis/final-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2) + '\n')
